passes.name: 2x Volts
passes.description: Every sale at the Power Plant pays double Volts. Stacks with VIP.

passes.name: Remote Sell
passes.description: Sell your charges from anywhere with the SELL button. No more walking back to the Power Plant!

passes.name: Big Bottles
passes.description: Every bottle you own holds 50% more charges, so you catch longer before selling.

passes.name: Lucky Charges
passes.description: Each charge you catch has a 15% chance to be worth double. Stacks with the Analyst for a rare x4 jackpot!

passes.name: Lab Grant
passes.description: Your Storm Society researchers set up instantly and gain field data twice as fast.

passes.name: VIP
passes.description: Golden bottle, golden lightning, a VIP chat tag and title, plus 10% more Volts on every sale.

passes.name: Bolt Colours
passes.description: Choose the colour of the lightning that arcs into your bottle. Everyone sees it!

passes.name: Jet Boots
passes.description: Run 50% faster between zones, with a jet trail. Speed inside storm zones is unchanged.

products.name: Pocket Charge
products.description: A pocketful of Volts: 200 charges' worth from your best zone.

products.name: Storm Jar
products.description: A jar of Volts: 1,000 charges' worth from your best zone.

products.name: Thunder Crate
products.description: A crate of Volts: 6,000 charges' worth from your best zone.

products.name: Lightning Vault
products.description: A vault of Volts: 40,000 charges' worth from your best zone.

boosts.name: 2x Volts Boost
boosts.description: 30 minutes of 2x Volts on every sale. Buy it for yourself or gift it to a friend!

boosts.name: Lucky Boost
boosts.description: 30 minutes of Lucky Charges: 15% of catches worth double. Buy it for yourself or gift it!

boosts.name: Big Bottles Boost
boosts.description: 30 minutes of bottles that hold 50% more. Buy it for yourself or gift it!

boosts.name: Boost Bundle
boosts.description: 1 hour of 2x Volts, Lucky Charges and Big Bottles together. Buy it for yourself or gift it!

boosts.name: Server Storm
boosts.description: Start a Server Storm: 2x Volts for everyone in your server for 15 minutes, with your name on it!
